components.name: Main hydraulic pump

rule.description: Pump vibration above expected, together with flow below expected or oil temperature above expected

components.position_note: Location approximate: under the engine hood of a generic harvester model, since main pumps are typically driven directly by the engine. Not from CAD.
components.procedure_note: Illustrative steps written by us. Not manufacturer service instructions.
procedure: Stop work, lower the crane and harvester head to the ground, switch off the engine and remove the key.
Release residual hydraulic pressure as the machine's manual instructs.
Look for oil leaks at the pump, hoses and fittings; check oil level and condition in the tank.
Check the return and drain filters and their clogging indicators.
With the machine running under controlled load, listen for abnormal pump noise and measure pressure and flow at the test points.
Compare measurements with the manufacturer's specification and decide: repair, replace, or keep monitoring.
After the work, run the after-repair check below and record what was found.
